en: Psalms 44
For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm.

zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。

p.src: 1  We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

en: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
u.src: 1  We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

p.src: 2  You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

en: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
u.src: 2  You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

p.src: 3  For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

en: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
u.src: 3  For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

p.src: 4  God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

en: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
u.src: 4  God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

p.src: 5  Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

en: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
u.src: 5  Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

p.src: 6  For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
u.src: 6  For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

p.src: 7  But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

en: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
u.src: 7  But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

p.src: 8  In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

en: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
u.src: 8  In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

p.src: 9  But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

en: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
u.src: 9  But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

p.src: 10  You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

en: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
u.src: 10  You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

p.src: 11  You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

en: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
u.src: 11  You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

p.src: 12  You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

en: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
u.src: 12  You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

p.src: 13  You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

en: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
u.src: 13  You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

p.src: 14  You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

en: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
u.src: 14  You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

p.src: 15  All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

en: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
u.src: 15  All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

p.src: 16  at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

en: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
u.src: 16  at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

p.src: 17  All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

en: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
u.src: 17  All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

p.src: 18  Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

en: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
u.src: 18  Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

p.src: 19  though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

en: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
u.src: 19  though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

p.src: 20  If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
u.src: 20  If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

p.src: 21  won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

en: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
u.src: 21  won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

p.src: 22  Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

en: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
u.src: 22  Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

p.src: 23  Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

en: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
u.src: 23  Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

en: 44:23 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

p.src: 24  Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

en: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
u.src: 24  Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

p.src: 25  For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
u.src: 25  For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

p.src: 26  Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

en: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
u.src: 26  Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
